children: Jhajharia brings over a decade of experience across corporate finance, structured finance, investment banking and supply chain finance

Surabhi Jhajharia has joined ANAROCK as Director – Alternative Assets & Corporate Finance, bringing experience in capital raising, structured transactions, investment advisory and corporate finance across real estate, education and healthcare. She will focus on capital solutions and transactions involving these sectors.
Jhajharia joins ANAROCK after more than 11 years at IndusInd Bank, where she held multiple leadership positions across corporate banking, education and supply chain finance.
Most recently, she served as Regional Head – Mid Market Group, Corporate Banking, overseeing a multi-sector portfolio with responsibilities spanning credit, structuring and client management.

Before this role, Jhajharia served as Head of Education, where she managed a Rs 2,900 cr disbursed portfolio across South India. Her work covered fund-based and non-fund working capital facilities, term loans, project loans, structured finance, foreign exchange products and liability products for clients in the education and healthcare sectors.

During her tenure at IndusInd Bank, Jhajharia also held several positions in supply chain finance. As Zonal Head – Supply Chain Finance for South and East, she worked on dealer and vendor finance programmes, factoring transactions and programme-level implementation.
She earlier headed Supply Chain Management, focusing on channel finance and vendor funding, while also working with manufacturing clients on financing programmes.

Before joining IndusInd Bank, Jhajharia worked as an independent consultant across investment banking, financial services and real estate. Her assignments included equity and debt transactions, fundraising, buy-side and sell-side mandates, and real estate-related transactions.
She was also Business Director at Leverage Capital Partners, where she worked on private equity and venture capital fund interactions, financial modelling and fund-raising mandates.

In her new role, Jhajharia will work across alternative assets and corporate finance, with a particular focus on education- and healthcare-linked real estate. Her experience spans capital raising, mergers and acquisitions, structured transactions and asset monetisation. Jhajharia holds an Executive MBA in General Management from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore. She is also a Chartered Secretary in Banking, Corporate, Finance and Securities Law from The Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland.
The appointment adds banking, structured finance and investment banking experience to ANAROCK’s work across alternative assets and sector-focused capital solutions.
